content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Terri Koch (E009)
Request: admin access to Payroll

There are two conflicting notes:
- Note 1 (from HR agent presumably): role Engineer, employment type full_time, recommendation: write for Payroll. Reasoning: full-time employee, admin only if role owns system; Engineer doesn't own Payroll, so max is write.
- Note 2 (from Security agent): role Engineer, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation: read for Payroll. Security DB is authoritative.

The conflict: HR says full-time, Security says contractor. Security DB is stated to be authoritative. So employment type is contractor with basic security training.

For contractors: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. With basic training, maximum is read.

Requested level: admin, which is above maximum (read). Grant the maximum: read.

Never grant more than requested. Read is at or below maximum. Grant read.

Let me submit decision with read.
